description: Crew was forced to depart Devon Island several hours ahead of the planned schedule, leaving insufficient time to complete all pre-planned winterisation tasks.
response: The Commander prioritised critical closure tasks and executed them rapidly. Incomplete items were noted for Crew 16.
lesson: Never defer winterisation tasks to the final day. Maintain a continuously updated closure checklist from mid-mission. The departure window can close suddenly.
pattern_tag: winterisation task deferral to departure day
source_citation: SRC-hypatia-iii-brief, Part IV – Incident and emergency register, §4.3 Operational incidents, lines 626-631. Register Crew tag: 'C15'. Sol: not stated; placed near end of C15's mission window (July 1-31) since this describes forced early departure. Confidence (B) rationale: narrative account of departure-day decision-making; daily/Commander-report style.
